name: Pet Posse Simulator
desc:
Hello there users!🧒 Are you up for an adventure?🌴 Welcome to Pet Posse!🎮 Join family and friends in this adventurous game.👪 Collect coins, unlock new areas, and hatch rare pets! 🏝️

Link your clothing to your pet for any price and gain Robux from every sale! Enter the world of Pet Posse! 🌟

Marketplace Disclaimer: All gamepasses and shirts are purchased on Roblox's end so we have no way to prevent a purchase if a player takes down their pet before you buy their product. You have been warned and there is an unlikely chance you will be refunded.
